In real estate, in Japan the company focuses on asset management and covers everything from development to property management, and overseas it handles development and operation. Revenue of 24,585 million yen by segment for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is the smallest of the 10 categories, while profit attributable to owners of the parent of 162,030 million yen is the largest, clearly showing a category where the ranking by revenue and the ranking by profit do not match.
